description: A close-up view of a crafting workspace features blue and green paper shapes arranged on a white surface with grey dots. A small, light blue square tile with a white letter V sits centrally among other geometric forms. The scene includes a cut piece of blue paper with a large curved opening and a green ruler in the bottom corner.
